property.name: employeeId
property.label: Employee ID
property.description: Optional override (Portal_Users__c Id). If blank, the component will only auto-use recordId when the record page is for Portal_Users__c; otherwise it will fall back to the logged-in portal user.

property.name: showEmployeesTab
property.label: Show Employees Tab
property.description: Optional. If unchecked, hides the Employees tab regardless of feature access.

property.name: showDashboardTab
property.label: Show Dashboard Tab
property.description: Optional. If unchecked, hides the Dashboard tab regardless of feature access.

property.name: showAttendanceTab
property.label: Show Attendance Tab
property.description: Optional. If unchecked, hides the Attendance tab regardless of feature access.

property.name: showPortalUsersTab
property.label: Show Portal Users Tab
property.description: Optional. If unchecked, hides the Portal Users sub-tab.

property.name: showSelectedUserTab
property.label: Show Selected User Tab
property.description: Optional. If unchecked, hides the Selected User sub-tab.

property.name: showPermissionsTab
property.label: Show Permissions Tab
property.description: Optional. If unchecked, hides the Permissions sub-tab.

property.name: employeesTabFeature
property.label: Employees Tab Feature Required
property.description: Optional. Feature label required to show Employees. Defaults to the site navigation label 'Employee Directory'.

property.name: dashboardTabFeature
property.label: Dashboard Tab Feature Required
property.description: Optional. Feature label required to show Dashboard. Defaults to no requirement (Dashboard is always visible on the site).

property.name: attendanceTabFeature
property.label: Attendance Tab Feature Required
property.description: Optional. Feature label required to show Attendance. Defaults to the site navigation label 'Attendance Management'.

property.name: portalUsersTabFeature
property.label: Portal Users Tab Feature Required
property.description: Optional. Feature name that must be present to show Portal Users. Defaults to Employees feature requirement.

property.name: selectedUserTabFeature
property.label: Selected User Tab Feature Required
property.description: Optional. Feature name that must be present to show Selected User. Defaults to Employees feature requirement.

property.name: permissionsTabFeature
property.label: Permissions Tab Feature Required
property.description: Optional. Feature name that must be present to show Permissions. Defaults to Employees feature requirement.
